pr_metadata.title: Complete public listing queries and explicit value editing; repair storage lifetime
pr_metadata.body:
## Why
The prior branch consolidation is complete, but public listing queries and explicit value removal were still missing. Review also reproduced stale transaction handles and malformed price-bound exceptions.

## Changes
- Add `listing list`, `listing show` and `search` over explicitly selected signed public files, using the same retention/search handlers as the PWA. Enforce 128 files, 1 MiB per file, 16 MiB total, bounded pages, deterministic ordering and snapshot checks.
- Add explicit **Remove declared value** editing for draft/unpublished listings. Preserve omitted values, exact amounts/currencies, history, ownership, revisions and inventory holds; sale publication still requires a value.
- Revoke public and underlying storage transaction methods when callbacks settle, before commit/rollback; block retained handles, synchronous microtasks and delayed blob writes.
- Reject malformed paired price bounds as ordinary validation failures.
- Update user guides and remaining work; preserve the incompatible historical draft #8 and existing compatibility/recovery limitations.

## Source and review
Base: `b6d99d87e9f67e76791f2dfff3e85015154cd92f`.
Published head: `3aa7a17b28ee07ebec4336b49c3527743510bc16` (browser journey correction included).
Local combined checkpoint: `b5e251c76159d262e3db46a70ff9bd2817220114`.
GitHub tree exactly matches local source: `92a6452b4241fbcafe13b334a154765bbac63c3e`.

Independent review found no blocker. Additional probes checked all 39 methods across nine transaction stores, cross-realm promises, and 128 independently signed listings paginated 100+28 without duplication or omission.

## Validation
First-head [Alpha run 44504114268](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/CLASSifiedisRUPTed/actions/runs/44504114268) checked test merge `f68098cda9d3bd0c6904468acab9289dcea9d401`: 748/748 domain assertions and 27/27 tooling tests passed, as did static/money/setup/build gates. Browser journeys completed **72 passed, 3 failed**. All three new value-removal journeys stopped at an exact `getByLabel` lookup for the nested listing-type select. The failure contexts identify the control's exact accessible combobox name. The correction uses that role/name, waits for completed unlocking, and verifies exact unpublished/published revisions instead of a loose substring. Timeouts and feature assertions remain intact. The failed run, contexts and screenshots are preserved. All six original-head CLI jobs were cancelled when the corrected head was pushed; they do not qualify the correction.

Fresh qualification is pending on the current head: [Alpha 44510361239](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/CLASSifiedisRUPTed/actions/runs/44510361239) and [CLI 44510361244](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/CLASSifiedisRUPTed/actions/runs/44510361244). This draft requires all three browser engines and all six OS/Node CLI jobs to pass before ordinary merge.

Focused implementation suites passed 46 CLI, 59 listing/editor, 30 storage lifecycle/close, one encrypted-vault lock/reopen and seven shared-search assertions. Counts overlap and must not be summed. The combined local static/money gates and 27/27 tooling tests passed before the browser correction. Original full local domain execution was killed (137); a serial retry completed 745/748 with an unchanged 60-second timeout and two unchanged performance-limit failures. A concurrent CLI run completed 44/46 with two unchanged 15-second subprocess timeouts. The correction's local typecheck was also killed (137), so no passing result is claimed for that invocation. Complete raw outcomes and hashes are retained in the local qualification record.

Local Chromium aborted at a denied socket before page execution: zero local browser journeys ran. Hosted results are the browser qualification evidence. Earlier main CI is not evidence for this candidate.

## Scope
No key/signature/backup-format change, implicit network/private-key access, deployment, release or historical branch deletion. Full backup recovery, native WebKit existing-key compatibility, private CLI phases and wider product work remain open.

## Durable qualification checkpoint
[Execution checkpoint and guarded handoff](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/CLASSifiedisRUPTed/tree/docs/classrup-feature-qualification-20261119/docs/development/evidence/20261119-feature-completion) preserve pending CI identities and local outcomes across the executor outage. This documentation branch is separate so the reviewed runtime head and its queued CI are unchanged.
